title: FREEMANS Test & Measure Green Beam Self Levelling 25m Cross Line Laser Level, with 4*AA Batteries fo
description: ★ 180° VERTICAL & 360° HORIZONTAL HIGH VISIBILITY GREEN LASER LINES★ Laser lines can be projected independently or together. Ultra bright green laser suitable for indoor use. 3 levels of brightness that can be adjusted as per jobsite conditions and/or user comfort (100%<75%<50%) ★ SELF-LEVELING & MANUAL MODES★ Easy front slide switch to operate between the 2 modes. In self-levelling mode, the Laser Level will automatically level upto ±3°, or else the laser lines will flash to indicate it is not level. In manual mode, the self-levelling function is deactivated, and the device can be manually placed at a pre-determined angle. ★ HANDS FREE USE★ The Laser Level can be mounted onto a tripod (1/4” Thread Mount) or affixed to most metal surfaces by using the Magnetic Mounting bracket (Included), allowing for hands free work. Applications include installing tiles, shelves, mirrors, photo frames, doors, windows, railings etc. ★ IP54 PROTECTION ★ The Laser Line Level has a IP54 protection grade (shock resistant, waterproof, dustproof, shockproof, wear resistant, impact resistance, cold and high temperature.). Convenient carry bag provided for easy storage and portability. ADVANCED CALCULATIONS IN < 2 SECONDS: Point and click to get distance measurements and also advanced calculations such as area, volume and Pythagorean indirect measurement single-handedly. HIGH LEVELS OF ACCURACY: The FREEMANS Laser Distance Meter boasts an accuracy of upto ±(2mm+d*1/10000), for a measurement range of upto 40m. ERGONOMIC DESIGN: Carefully designed plastic body for comfortable handling, and a backlit screen for better visibility in dark areas. Item size ‎10.4x4.3x2.5cm. IN THE PACKAGE: Laser Distance Meter, Carry Bag, Instruction Manual, 2 1.5V AAA batteries and Warranty card.
